decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet shelf display is a flexible core format close to the established offer, though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 suggests it may be getting less prominence.
The pegboard-back display still serves hanging-product promotions on existing production lines, but its absence from the website raises some risk that it gets folded into standard formats.
The standard quarter-pallet display is a staple retail format with steady brand demand and costs little to keep.
The eighth-pallet display completes the pallet-size range and is cheap to maintain alongside related formats.
Physical media keeps shrinking, which makes this niche display a likely candidate for removal, but it is close to the core offer and can still be produced on demand.
